summary: Refactored apps/agent-server/src/projects/project-catalog.ts behavior-preservingly into cohesive modules while keeping the ProjectCatalog public API and import path stable. Split browser/search, catalog persistence, config normalization/persistence/migration, and integration resolution into separate files, and added a reusable AsyncMutex; reduced the facade to 196 LOC with all files ≤300 LOC.
decisions: Extracted project browser/search to project-browser.ts (62 LOC) to isolate filesystem traversal and matching scoring from catalog state.
Extracted catalog JSON persistence to project-catalog-store.ts (56 LOC) with atomic writeFile+rename, encapsulating CatalogProject storage.
Extracted config normalization, parsing via parseProjectConfig, persistence, and legacy .gizmo/profiles.json migration to project-config-store.ts (204 LOC), guarded by a mutex.
Added reusable async-mutex.ts (18 LOC) with run<T>() for serializing async operations across stores.
Extracted integration resolution to project-integration-resolver.ts (31 LOC) combining overrides, registeredExtensions, and globally disabled extensions.
Kept ProjectCatalog class and import path unchanged as a coordinating facade that delegates to the new modules.
